pregens.name: Bran
pregens.notes: Human (he/him), former caravan guard. Best move: swing your sword (+5, 1d8+5). Second Wind once per fight: heal 1d10+1. Everything else +0.

pregens.name: Doran
pregens.notes: Dwarf priest (he/him); sees in the dark, speaks Draconic. Carries a little copper ring from his husband, Tomas, who runs the bakery back home; likes to say "Tomas would love this place." Best move: Heal, 3 uses, ally regains 1d8+3. Everything else +0.

pregens.name: Vex

attack.name: Sneaky shot
attack.damage: 1d6+3 (+1d6 if a friend is next to the target)

pregens.notes: Halfling (he/him). Best move: sneaky shot. Everything else +0.

pregens.name: Rook Ashgrove
pregens.notes: Human (he/him), intrepid adventurer with loose morals. Joins in the comedy branch when swap_rogue_to_ranger is set; Vex's player takes him. Best move: longbow (+5, 1d8+3). One trick: once per fight, add 1d6 to a hit. Everything else +0.

scenes.title: The Tavern
scenes.text: Rain taps on the windows of the Bramble & Barrel, the coziest tavern in Larkhollow. Above the fireplace there's an empty iron hook. Marigold Fenn cries, "Friends, somebody has stolen the Starlantern!" She'll pay 60 gold and gives you 2 healing potions and a basket of meat pies.

options.label: Talk: ask Marigold for more gold

success.text: She offers 75 gold! She hugs you and points at the back window.

fail.text: Marigold hugs you anyway and points at the back window.

options.label: Clever: look at the back window right away

success.text: You hurry to the back window.

fail.text: You hurry to the back window.

options.label: Fight: arm-wrestle Big Dunstan the blacksmith

success.text: The whole tavern cheers, and Marigold adds a third potion! She points at the back window.

fail.text: Dunstan wins, but Marigold hugs you and points at the back window.

scenes.title: Clues
scenes.text: The clues all point to Hammerdeep Mine on Millstone Hill. Which clue do you chase?

options.label: Clever: study the back window

success.text: Tiny three-toed footprints and a copper scale. Kobolds! The red mud only comes from Millstone Hill.

fail.text: Tiny three-toed muddy footprints and a shiny copper scale.

options.label: Talk: visit Tobias the candlemaker

success.text: A slate drawing: six eggs in a ring of candles. "They're not threatening anyone. Their eggs are cold." Tobias gives you a box of candles.

fail.text: His candles keep vanishing; the thieves left a slate drawing of six eggs ringed by candles. He gives you a box of candles anyway.

options.label: Talk: ask Old Wenna the goatherd

success.text: "Little dragons carried a glowing star into the old dwarf mine. The dwarves left a magic warm-stone deep inside, behind a door with a sun on it."

fail.text: "Saw little dragons carrying a glowing star up the hill into the old dwarf mine. One waved!"

scenes.title: The Goblin Toll
scenes.text: At a rickety bridge, two goblins have hung a rope of tin cans by a sign: TOL BRIDJ. 5 SILVURS EECH. "Halt, pay King Snag or else!" "Or else what, boss?" whispers the round one, chewing an onion.

options.label: Talk: haggle with Snag

success.text: Snag lowers the toll to "1 silver and a compliment" and brags, "We saw the lizard-folk go by with a shiny lamp!"

fail.text: You pay 15 silver. Snag brags, "We saw the lizard-folk go by with a shiny lamp!"

options.label: Clever: give Mudge a meat pie

success.text: Mudge switches sides and Snag gives up. Across you go!

fail.text: Mudge switches sides and Snag gives up. Across you go!

options.label: Fight the goblins

success.text: Swords out!

fail.text: Swords out!

scenes.title: Fight: Snag and Mudge
scenes.text: Snag waves a rusty sword. Mudge hides behind the sign. Each turn you move and do one thing. Roll to hit: if you beat their number, you score a hit.

options.label: Fight: attack Snag

success.text: Hit! Snag goes down and Mudge cries "TACTICAL RETREAT!"

fail.text: Snag's rusty sword nicks you!

options.label: Fight: attack Mudge

success.text: Mudge goes down and Snag gives up!

fail.text: An onion bonks you!

options.label: Talk: glare at Mudge

success.text: Mudge surrenders the moment you glare. Snag gives up too.

fail.text: Mudge surrenders the moment you glare. Snag gives up too.

scenes.title: The Fork in the Road
scenes.text: The road splits. The main road winds toward the bridge. A sunny meadow shortcut cuts across the hill. A cow stands at the fork, chewing slowly, looking like she knows things.

options.label: Clever: take the main road

success.text: You stick to the main road toward the bridge.

fail.text: You stick to the main road toward the bridge.

options.label: Talk: ask the cow which way

success.text: The cow moos once, firmly, at the main road. You trust the cow.

fail.text: The cow just chews. You take the main road anyway.

options.label: Sneak: take the meadow shortcut

success.text: Daisies, butterflies, a lovely breeze. What could go wrong?

fail.text: Daisies, butterflies, a lovely breeze. What could go wrong?

scenes.title: Something Falls from the Sky
scenes.text: A whistle from above. A glowing black sword with a tiny grinning face on the hilt drops out of the clouds and lands, point first, right in Vex's backside. Vex looks back, sighs happily, says "oh yeah, that's the stuff," and topples gently into the daisies. Somehow he looks very comfortable. The sword giggles.

options.label: Talk: say a few kind words for Vex

success.text: Doran says something lovely. Bran sniffs loudly and says it's hay fever.

fail.text: Doran says something lovely. Bran sniffs loudly and says it's hay fever.

options.label: Clever: pull out the sword and look at it

success.text: It's a demon sword, and it's homesick. It hums a sad little tune.

fail.text: It hums at you, rudely. You wrap it in a blanket.

options.label: Sneak: check Vex's pockets for anything useful

success.text: You find a gold tooth. Nobody asks whose.

fail.text: Just lint and an IOU. Vex would want you to keep moving.

scenes.title: A Stranger in the Meadow
scenes.text: A tall man in a very muddy cloak strolls out of the trees with a longbow. "Rook Ashgrove, adventurer. That sword's mine. Well, it's mine now. Well, it's nobody's. Need a hand?" (The player who had Vex now plays Rook.)

options.label: Talk: welcome Rook to the party

success.text: Rook shakes hands with everyone and returns Bran's coin purse, which nobody saw him take.

fail.text: Rook shakes hands with everyone and returns Bran's coin purse, which nobody saw him take.

options.label: Talk: Doran compliments Rook's boots

success.text: Rook: "You've got good taste, priest." Doran goes pink and suddenly talks a lot about Tomas, his husband who bakes bread.

fail.text: Rook: "You've got good taste, priest." Doran goes pink and suddenly talks a lot about Tomas, his husband who bakes bread.

options.label: Clever: ask what he's really after

success.text: "Treasure, mostly. Also a fun time." Honest, at least.

fail.text: Rook winks. You learn nothing.

scenes.title: Grubnax
scenes.text: With a pop and a puff of smoke, a red demon the size of a teapot appears on the sword. "I am GRUBNAX, Terror of the Ninth Pit! That's MY sword and I want to GO HOME!" He stomps his tiny hoof.

options.label: Talk: offer to help him get home

success.text: Grubnax sniffles. "Really? Nobody's ever helped me." He points to an old stone altar on the hill.

fail.text: "LIES!" He charges your ankles.

options.label: Clever: offer him a meat pie

success.text: Grubnax eats the pie in one bite, cries a little, and says the altar is up the hill.

fail.text: Grubnax eats the pie in one bite, cries a little, and says the altar is up the hill.

options.label: Fight: swat the little demon

success.text: Grubnax shrieks and flaps at your faces!

fail.text: Grubnax shrieks and flaps at your faces!

scenes.title: Fight: Grubnax
scenes.text: Grubnax buzzes around your heads, biting ears. Two good hits will make him give up.

options.label: Fight: swat Grubnax

success.text: SWAT! Grubnax bounces off a rock.

fail.text: He bites your ear!

options.label: Clever: offer a pie instead

success.text: Grubnax stops mid-air and eats the pie. Fight over.

fail.text: Grubnax stops mid-air and eats the pie. Fight over.

options.label: Clever: Rook does his distraction dance

success.text: Rook's dance is so baffling that Grubnax forgets why he was angry.

fail.text: The dance is terrible, but Grubnax laughs so hard he gives up.

scenes.title: The Old Altar
scenes.text: A cracked stone altar sits on the hilltop. Grubnax hops on with his sword. "Push it in, and I go home. Please?"

options.label: Fight: shove the sword into the altar

success.text: FWOOMP! Grubnax waves goodbye and vanishes with the sword.

fail.text: It sticks, then slides in. FWOOMP! Grubnax is gone.

options.label: Clever: read the old words on the altar

success.text: Doran reads the words, the altar glows, and Grubnax pops home with his sword.

fail.text: Doran mumbles; it works anyway. Grubnax is gone.

options.label: Talk: say goodbye to Grubnax

success.text: Grubnax hugs Bran's shin and vanishes with his sword.

fail.text: Grubnax hugs Bran's shin and vanishes with his sword.

scenes.title: Campfire
scenes.text: Night falls, so you camp by the hill. The fire crackles. Doran sits on Rook's log, moves to another log, then moves back.

options.label: Talk: Rook tells Doran he has kind eyes

success.text: Rook: "Nobody's ever noticed that." Doran grips Tomas's ring and coughs.

fail.text: Rook: "Nobody's ever noticed that." Doran grips Tomas's ring and coughs.

options.label: Talk: Rook and Doran share the night watch

success.text: Rook and Doran take the night watch together. The stars come out.

fail.text: Rook and Doran take the night watch together. The stars come out.

options.label: Clever: everyone just goes to sleep

success.text: Bran snores like a bear. Everyone sleeps.

fail.text: Bran snores like a bear. Everyone sleeps.

scenes.title: Later by the Fire
scenes.text: The fire burns low. Doran is very interested in his boots. Rook is very interested in the stars.

options.label: Talk: Rook and Doran share the night watch

success.text: Rook and Doran take the night watch together. The stars come out.

fail.text: Rook and Doran take the night watch together. The stars come out.

options.label: Talk: Doran tells a long story about Tomas's bread

success.text: Everyone falls asleep halfway through the part about sourdough.

fail.text: Everyone falls asleep halfway through the part about sourdough.

options.label: Clever: everyone just goes to sleep

success.text: Bran snores like a bear. Everyone sleeps.

fail.text: Bran snores like a bear. Everyone sleeps.

scenes.title: An Awkward Morning
scenes.text: Something happened between them that night, and neither will talk about it. Doran polishes Tomas's ring so hard it squeaks. Bran: "...What did I miss?"

options.label: Talk: nobody answers Bran

success.text: Total silence. A bird chirps. You head for the mine.

fail.text: Total silence. A bird chirps. You head for the mine.

options.label: Talk: Doran writes Tomas a very long letter

success.text: Three pages, mostly about bread. You head for the mine.

fail.text: Three pages, mostly about bread. You head for the mine.

options.label: Clever: Rook changes the subject to treasure

success.text: "So! The mine!" Everyone agrees very quickly.

fail.text: "So! The mine!" Everyone agrees very quickly.

scenes.title: Morning
scenes.text: The sun comes up. Bran makes burnt porridge. Everyone feels ready.

options.label: Head for the mine

success.text: Up Millstone Hill you go.

fail.text: Up Millstone Hill you go.

options.label: Talk: thank the cow on the way

success.text: A different cow. She doesn't care. To the mine!

fail.text: A different cow. She doesn't care. To the mine!

options.label: Clever: check your gear

success.text: Everything's packed. To the mine!

fail.text: Everything's packed. To the mine!

scenes.title: Pip at the Gate
scenes.text: A wall of junk blocks the tunnel. Behind it, a cat-sized kobold in a teapot helmet waves a fork on a stick: "Halt, I am Pip, Fiercest Guard, and VERY dangerous!" Then he sneezes.

options.label: Talk: make friends with Pip (mention the eggs, or offer a pie or candle)

success.text: Automatic success! Pip opens the gate. "Eggs are cold. Old warm-rock is locked behind the sun door." He joins you!

fail.text: Automatic success! Pip opens the gate. "Eggs are cold. Old warm-rock is locked behind the sun door." He joins you!

options.label: Clever: climb over the junk while Pip isn't looking

success.text: You slip over the junk unseen.

fail.text: A wheel clatters, Pip rings the gong and runs. Grizzle will be expecting you.

options.label: Fight: rush him

success.text: Pip squeaks, rings the gong, and runs away. He won't help you.

fail.text: Pip squeaks, rings the gong, and runs away. He won't help you.

scenes.title: The Three-Lights Door
scenes.text: A huge round stone door has one dial with three carvings: a Sun, a Moon, and a Star. Above it a golden sun shines on an anvil, with the words: "The forge wakes with the day."

options.label: Talk: ask Pip for help

success.text: "Big shiny sun. Dwarves like sun." You turn the dial to the Sun and the door rumbles open.

fail.text: "Big shiny sun. Dwarves like sun." You turn the dial to the Sun and the door rumbles open.

options.label: Clever: read the carving and turn the dial to the Sun

success.text: The door rumbles open!

fail.text: A puff of chalk dust: "NOPE!" Then you notice the painted sun, try again, and the door opens.

options.label: Fight: force the door open

success.text: The door grinds open!

fail.text: You get it open eventually, but the "NOPE!" voice laughs the whole time.

scenes.title: Behind the Door
scenes.text: In a dusty dwarf forge, a smooth gray rock sits in a stone cradle. When you pick it up, a warm orange glow wakes inside it. This is the Hearthstone! Beside it is a chest with 25 gold.

options.label: Take the Hearthstone and go on

success.text: You carry the warm stone deeper.

fail.text: You carry the warm stone deeper.

options.label: Talk: thank the old dwarves out loud

success.text: Your voice echoes kindly. On you go.

fail.text: Your voice echoes kindly. On you go.

options.label: Clever: check the chest twice

success.text: Just the 25 gold. On you go.

fail.text: Just the 25 gold. On you go.

scenes.title: The Larder
scenes.text: Three giant rats are gobbling spilled grain. On the top shelf a tiny kobold clutches a jar and sobs, "Go 'WAY, bad rats! That's the EGG-FOOD!"

options.label: Talk: call to Tib, "Jump, we'll catch you!"

success.text: You catch Tib! "The big-folk are GOOD!"

fail.text: Tib lands on someone's head. It works, with less dignity.

options.label: Clever: toss the meat pies into a far corner

success.text: The rats chase the food, and you rescue Tib.

fail.text: The rats chase the food, and you rescue Tib.

options.label: Fight the rats

success.text: The rats turn toward you!

fail.text: The rats turn toward you!

scenes.title: Fight: 3 Giant Rats
scenes.text: Three hungry rats snap at you. Beat their number to score a hit.

options.label: Fight: attack a rat

success.text: Hit! A rat goes down.

fail.text: A rat bites you!

options.label: Clever: throw food

success.text: Throwing food ends the fight. The rats scurry off and you rescue Tib.

fail.text: Throwing food ends the fight. The rats scurry off and you rescue Tib.

options.label: Talk: drink a healing potion

success.text: You feel better.

fail.text: You feel better.

scenes.title: Kobold Stash
scenes.text: In a pickle jar you find 1 healing potion and Tobias's missing candles. A blanket hides a tunnel down. A squeaky voice echoes: "WHO'S THERE? Grizzle Copperclaw is NOT afraid!"

options.label: Go down the tunnel

success.text: Down you go.

fail.text: Down you go.

options.label: Talk: call out "We're friends!"

success.text: The voice goes quiet. Down you go.

fail.text: The voice goes quiet. Down you go.

options.label: Clever: creep down quietly

success.text: Down you go.

fail.text: Down you go.

scenes.title: Grizzle's Hatchery
scenes.text: Six copper eggs lie in a nest of socks inside a cold forge. The Starlantern hangs on an anvil. A three-foot kobold in a tablecloth cape and slipping pot helmet squeaks, "I am GRIZZLE COPPERCLAW, my babies are COLD, and you will NOT take the sky-lamp!"

options.label: Talk: give her the Hearthstone

success.text: The Hearthstone flares orange in the forge and an egg gives a happy wobble. "You woke the warm-rock... for us?" She hands over the Starlantern.

fail.text: The Hearthstone flares orange in the forge and an egg gives a happy wobble. "You woke the warm-rock... for us?" She hands over the Starlantern.

options.label: Talk: offer help (candles, blankets, Marigold's promise)

success.text: Grizzle's eyes go soft. She hands over the Starlantern.

fail.text: "Prove it!" You add one more gift and a heartfelt sentence, and it works. She hands over the Starlantern.

options.label: Fight Grizzle and her helpers

success.text: Grizzle raises her spear!

fail.text: Grizzle raises her spear!

scenes.title: Fight: Grizzle Copperclaw
scenes.text: Grizzle jabs with her spear while two egg-minders hide behind the forge. Her pot helmet keeps slipping over her eyes...

options.label: Fight: "I hit the pot!"

success.text: CLANG! The pot falls over her eyes.

fail.text: Her spear jabs you!

options.label: Talk: give her the Hearthstone

success.text: The Hearthstone flares orange in the forge. Grizzle throws down her spear and hands over the Starlantern.

fail.text: The Hearthstone flares orange in the forge. Grizzle throws down her spear and hands over the Starlantern.

options.label: Talk: drink a healing potion

success.text: You feel better.

fail.text: You feel better.

combat.surrender_text: "Take the lamp! Just... not the babies."

scenes.title: Lantern Night
scenes.text: You come down Millstone Hill with the Starlantern held high, and the whole village cheers. That night the lantern blazes silver while a thousand paper lanterns float up. At the edge of the firelight, Pip waves like crazy. The End... for now.

rewards.gold: 60 gold from Marigold (75 if haggled) + 25 from the dwarf chest, about 30 each
rewards.item: Copperclaw Lucky Scale: once per session, reroll a 1 on the big die

level_up.Fighter: 20 HP; once per session take two actions on one turn
level_up.Cleric: 21 HP; Heal goes up to 4 uses
level_up.Rogue: 17 HP; every turn, hide or dash for free

scenes.wrap_up_prompt: What does your hero do at the festival?
